title: Abivax releases the results of its May 30, 2024 Ordinary and Extraordinary General Meeting
description: PARIS, France, June 4, 2024 – Abivax SA (Euronext Paris & Nasdaq: ABVX) (“Abivax” or the “Company”), a clinical-stage biotechnology company focused on developing therapeutics that harness the body’s natural regulatory mechanisms to stabilize the immune response in patients with chronic inflammatory diseases, held its ordinary and extraordinary general meeting of shareholders on May 30, 2024 (the “General Meeting”), which was chaired by Mr. Marc de Garidel, CEO and Chairman of the Board of Directors of Abivax (“Board”).

title: Inflammatory Bowel Disease Treatment Market Size Expected to Reach USD 33.19 Bn by 2032 - GlobeNewswire
description: The global inflammatory bowel disease treatment market is expected to grow from $19.91 billion in 2023 to $33.19 billion by 2032, driven by increasing prevalence, advancements in biologics, and the use of combination therapies. North America and Asia-Pacific are the key growth regions.

title: Abivax Reports Positive Interim Efficacy and Safety Analysis of Once-Daily 25mg Obefazimod in Moderate to Severe Ulcerative Colitis Patients After 2-Years of Open-Label Maintenance
description: Abivax's drug candidate obefazimod demonstrated maintenance of clinical remission and a favorable safety profile in a long-term study of ulcerative colitis patients, supporting its potential as a treatment option.

title: Abivax Announces First Patient Enrolled in ENHANCE-CD, the Phase 2b Trial of Obefazimod in Crohn’s Disease
description: Abivax announced the enrollment of the first patient in its Phase 2b ENHANCE-CD trial evaluating obefazimod, an investigational drug, for the treatment of moderately to severely active Crohn's disease.

title: Abivax Congratulates Victor Ambros and Gary Ruvkun on Their Nobel Prize for the Discovery of microRNA and its Role in Post-Transcriptional Gene Regulation
description: Abivax congratulates Victor Ambros and Gary Ruvkun on winning the Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine for their groundbreaking work on microRNA and its role in gene regulation. Abivax's lead drug candidate, obefazimod, acts by enhancing the expression of microRNA-124, which is relevant for treating chronic inflammatory diseases.
